scenario: a second start() arms a second tick interval, and stop() leaves one running
reason: Owner-approved 2026-11-01 (decisions page row s): in 1.35 every start() arms a new tick interval, even while the system is running or after destroy(), and keeps only the newest handle, so ticks multiply and an older interval keeps firing after stop() or destroy(); 2.0 arms the tick only on a start() that starts the system, and stop() and destroy() clear it. In this scenario a second start() while running, then stop(), destroy() and start() again are followed by clock advances; 1.35 keeps extra tick intervals firing (more ticks, and a timer still pending after destroy()), 2.0 ticks once per running period and nothing after stop() or destroy(). This covers the scenario's "tick" record, where the value at data[2] differs in step 2.
